simple.meaning: בִּלְשָׁן (Bilshân) is a Hebrew word meaning “Bilshan , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בִּלְשָׁן (H1114) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:2, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בִּלְשָׁן (H1114) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בִּלְשָׁן (H1114) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בִּלְשָׁן (Bilshân) / H1114 is traced through Ezra 2:2, Nehemiah 7:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
